payload.summary: Every charge Norwich City Council makes in 2026-27, from garden waste collections to burials, in one long PDF. The table headed “Alcohol / Entertainment / Late night refreshment” is the one that matters here: it gives the fee for each type of licence application and the annual charge for each rateable-value band, from £70 up to £1,050. Those amounts come from national regulations, so the council is publishing them rather than choosing them.
